title: Subscription
description: One RSS/Atom feed the operator subscribes to. Created by the operator (memogarden import opml); the provider enumerates Subscription facts to build the poll set. xml_url is the permanent identity anchor and never changes on redirects.

xml_url.description: The feed URL as configured (OPML xmlUrl, whitespace-stripped). Dedup key; identity never changes on 301/308.

html_url.description: Site URL (OPML htmlUrl / feed link rel=alternate)
